title: carlina brachylepis var. lanigera
intro: Carlina brachylepis var. lanigera, commonly known as Carline thistle, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Carline thistle include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
